description: This file contains classes and methods related to rendering installed fonts within the PDFsharp library, including functionality for multi-page rendering, font selection, and exclusion filtering.

classes.name: RenderInstalledFonts
classes.description: A class providing test methods to render installed fonts as PDF and show/save the output.

classes.name: RenderInstalledFontsSnippet
classes.description: A class encapsulating the logic to render font samples into PDFs, including multi-page support, font filtering, and rendering logic.

methods.name: RenderInstalledFontsTest
methods.description: A test method that creates a PDF with installed fonts using a snippet.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdf
methods.description: Static method that renders a font snippet to PDF and shows or saves the file depending on the environment.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders the snippet graphical content onto the provided graphics context.

methods.name: RenderSnippetMultiPage
methods.description: Performs multi-page rendering of font samples, initializing the font list and handling pagination.

methods.name: RenderSnippetAsPdfMultiPage
methods.description: Creates a multi-page PDF document with font samples.

methods.name: TryDrawString
methods.description: Attempts to draw a string with a specified font style, with exception handling for excluded fonts.

methods.name: IsFontExcluded
methods.description: Checks whether a font and style are excluded based on exclusion lists.
